title: CFTC Orders Kalshi to Halt Betting on Trump Speeches
excerpt: Prediction market platform Kalshi has stopped allowing users to wager on Donald Trump's speeches following an order from the CFTC.
body_html:
The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has directed the prediction market platform Kalshi to halt wagering on Donald Trump's speeches.

Kalshi's chief executive officer has complied with the regulatory directive. However, the platform's leadership has expressed opposition to the move by the agency.

The decision impacts the platform's offerings related to specific political events and public addresses.
